[2109.13704] Common Artifacts in Volume Rendering - arXiv.org
Direct Volume Rendering is a popular and powerful visualization method for voxel data and other volumetric scalar data sets. Particularly, in medical applications volume rendering is very commonly used, and has become one of the state of the art methods for 3D visualization of medical data.
